newsitem.title: USA: Bain Capital buys $100 mln stake in Walco.
newsitem.headline: Bain Capital buys $100 mln stake in Walco.

text.p: Bain Capital Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire a majority interest in Walco International Inc, a distributor of health products for cattle, in a transaction valued at about $100 million.

Certain members of Walco's management and of the Wall family -- the firm was founded by F. Willard Wall -- will retain an equity interest in the company and continue to manage the business, said the company.
Walco distributes and markets approximately 12,000 animal health-care products to over 40,000 customers in the U.S. and Canada. The firm currently has revenues of $320 million.
Walco said that Bain would be a strategic partner for making the transition from a family-owned and run business to a leading-edge distributor of food-animal health products.
Bain Capital is a private equity investment firm which focuses on value-oriented investments in the distribution, manufacturing, consumer products, retail and business services arenas.
